title: The Threatening Magnetic and Plasma Environment of the TRAPPIST-1 Planets

evidence.locator: Section 2: the wind is modeled with the BATS-R-US code's Alfvén Wave Solar Model, driven by the magnetic map of the proxy star GJ 3622 scaled to mean surface fields of about 600 G and 300 G. Section 3: wind speeds reach close to 1,400 km/s; plasma densities at the planets are 10^4 to 10^5 times the solar wind's at 1 au; all but the outermost planet spend a large fraction of their orbits inside the Alfvén surface, crossing it four times an orbit; the total pressure at the orbits is 3 to 6 orders of magnitude above the solar wind's at 1 au; the mass loss is about 3e-14 solar masses a year.

Source bundle, 7,485,505 bytes; member TrB2_2D_0deg_tot.png (131,566 bytes, 2,000 by 1,778 pixels) is Figure 3, left: the total pressure in the plane of the orbits for the 600 G field, the seven orbits as colored circles and the Alfvén surface as a white line. The figure prints no color bar.
